text:
maya: noticed embeddings-eu-west1 memory and error noise since ~00:40 UTC (~4.1% errors). likely kvcache churn on long-prefix workloads. thinking tenant-scoped hotfix + toggle approach instead of full region cutover. planning a fast approval during the 01:00-01:30 UTC change window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2026-550 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-hotfix-b. rollout options: tenant-toggle (priority-tenants first) OR region-shift to eu-west2. default plan: tenant-toggle 0->10% priority tenants -> 100% priority tenants -> global if clean.
duncan: tenant-toggle preferred. keeps blast radius small. need infra lead expedited ok to bypass standard 10m wait for priority tenants. tagging @rana for signoff.
selena: platform QA: lab runs on eu-west2 show mem churn down ~35%, p95 stable. we'll keep v3.2.0 pinned on eu-west1 for instant fallback. can add a route flag to flip tenants back quickly.
maya: rollback triggers: immediate toggle back to eu-west1 pinned v3.2.0 if priority-tenant errors > 0.8% OR p95 increases >180ms sustained 2m OR any OOMs. ops-bot: rollback thresholds recorded.
henry: ops: add a kill-switch route flag and temp alert for p95>180ms/errors>0.8% for priority tenants. escalate to oncall -> infra-lead.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-8300 created. escalation chain: oncall -> infra-lead. Temp route flag created: route.priority-tenants.override=eu-west1-pin-v3.2.0.
duncan: can we get a fast DM approval from infra lead? rana: can you greenlight expedited tenant toggle and cadence (5m at 10% pri-tenants, then 10m at 100% pri-tenants)?
rana: rana: approved via DM. cadence accepted: 5m@10% for priority tenants, then 10m@100% for priority tenants. proceed to broader ramp only if metrics are clean. post release note to #release-notes after cutoff.
selena: I'll own telemetry, traces, and heap profiles during the window. maya: please include commands for quick toggle and rollback in runbook.
maya: runbook snippet: 
```
# toggle priority tenants to hotfix image
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix-b --filter tenants=priority --percent 10 --note "DR-2026-550-prio-10pct"
# flip all priority tenants to 100%
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix-b --filter tenants=priority --percent 100 --note "DR-2026-550-prio-100pct"
# immediate rollback toggle back to pinned eu-west1
routectl set --scope tenants=priority --route-override route.priority-tenants.override
# rollback image command
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west1 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
selena: commands look good. i'll monitor kv cache hit ratio, heap churn, p95, error budget, and priority-tenant traces.
duncan: ops-bot schedule DR-2026-550 for 01:00 UTC. who will be on call?
ops-bot: Scheduled: DR-2026-550 will start at 01:00 UTC. Operators: maya, selena, duncan, henry.
henry: i'll stand up the temporary dashboards and be ready to flip the route flag. please DM me for immediate rollback.
releasebot: Release note draft attached to DR-2026-550: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix-b — kvcache leak mitigation for high-prefix reuse; no change to model outputs." Link: https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-550
duncan: post-deploy checklist: confirm priority-tenant error <0.5%, kv cache hit ratio stable, p95 within 150ms of baseline, no OOMs. i'll provide final signoff at 01:18 if all green.
maya: agreed. if any segfaults/OOMs or thresholds breach, immediate toggle back and rollback. otherwise proceed with broader ramp after 01:20. :thumbsup:
selena: posting release note to #release-notes once we start.
releasebot: Posted: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix-b — kvcache mitigation" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-550
duncan: thanks team. closing here; will update with status after hold window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
